The '''Chryya system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chryya]].
